Cheyenne: hey 👋 i'm Cheyenne, started today as SDR (APAC TZ). quick setup q's: HubSpot seat still pending, Dialpad extension not showing in the desktop app, and where's the latest outbound playbook + call scripts? who do I ping for fast access? cc @Marco @Alisha
Marco: welcome Cheyenne!! 🎉 i'll sort the HubSpot + Dialpad. can you fill this quick provisioning form first? https://redwood.internal/provisioning (choose "sales - SDR")
Marco: needed: legal name, work email, manager, start date, timezone, preferred number type (softphone/hardphone)
Cheyenne: done — submitted the form (confirmation 1788887777). form shows default number type "softphone". also my Dialpad app still shows "No extension assigned" on desktop.
ProvisionBot: Ticket #32457 created for user cheyenne@redwood.ai -> assignment: sales-ops
Alisha (sales-ops): assigned. Cheyenne, i see your form. HubSpot seat queued, should be in ~20-30m. For Dialpad: check Admin Console > Users. If still not there, sign out of the desktop app and remove cache: Preferences > Advanced > Clear cache, then sign in again.
Alisha (sales-ops): If that doesn't work, i'll force-create the user and push number. tell me if you prefer a local APAC number or US overflow.
Cheyenne: APAC preferred. also curious about voicemail transcription & call recordings — do we get that by default for SDRs? want to tag important calls for CS handoff.
Marco: recordings are ON by default for sales seats, but transcription is gated by compliance config. ping @Katie and she'll enable the transcript flag for your team.
Katie (security): hey — i can enable transcription for the SDR cohort after a short privacy review. please DM me the list of emails that need transcripts and confirm you'll follow the playbook redaction guidelines.
Cheyenne: DM sent with emails. thanks! also — where's the canonical outbound playbook? lots of quick reference scripts would help.
DevEx Bot: Latest playbook published: Sales Outbound v3 — https://redwood.notionsite/sales/outbound-v3 (includes 3 scripts, objection handling cheat sheet, and call tagging matrix)
Marco: also add the Drive folder for collateral: drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-redwood-sales-collateral. Templates: GCal invite template, voicemail script, email 1/2/3.
Cheyenne: perfect. one more tiny thing — calls through Dialpad don't seem to show up in HubSpot activity for me.
Alisha (sales-ops): that's usually the Dialpad <> HubSpot webhook. i'm rechecking the integration. can you confirm your HubSpot user email matches your Dialpad work email?
Cheyenne: yep they're the same (cheyenne@redwood.ai)
Alisha (sales-ops): ok i'm forcing a re-sync now. if you still don't see calls in 15m, reply here and i'll escalate to eng-infra.
Cheyenne: awesome, thanks everyone 🙏 
Marco: welcome again — shout if anything else. ps: join the sales-standup 9:30am PT — link in calendar. :rocket:
Cheyenne: on it, joining. :)
